text: Here I am, surrounded by the clear lines of glass and the calculated arrangement of chairs, feeling both invited and watched by the sterile transparency of this space. The next moment, I find myself before a vibrant wall celebrating research and development, my spirit stirring with curiosity. I feel a quiet excitement—the energy of inquiry and potential innovation hums gently in the air around me, as if urging me to contemplate the endless interplay between humans and technology.
